overview: The board approved a special permit for a residential addition on Arlington Street and continued a hearing for a multi-unit development on Elm Street. Members also acknowledged the resignation of the board's chair and discussed the process for electing a successor.

items.title: 85 Elm Street (Case A-2024-25)
items.summary: Continued the matter to the February meeting at the request of the applicant. Attorney Kathleen Desmond stated the owner needed more time to prepare financial evidence following a fire that displaced tenants at another property.

items.title: 171 Arlington Street (Case A-2025-01)
items.summary: Approved a special permit to extend an existing non-conforming side yard setback for a residential addition. The board determined the project would not cause substantial detriment to the neighborhood, noting the addition faces a neighbor's parking area rather than a house.

items.title: Administrative Updates
items.summary: Acknowledged the resignation of Chair Jamie Thompson and planned an election for a new chair at the next meeting. Staff reported on testing AI software to assist with the backlog of meeting minutes.
